reactions.quote: Of the eight diamines, those with a carbon chain length from C2 (ethylenedi- amine) to C7 (1,7-diaminoheptane) were recognized by the enzyme. Moreover, enzyme activity was highest for C3 (1,3-diaminopropane) and tended to decrease as the carbon chain length increased. PnPHT1 activity was also detected for three polyamines, albeit at lower levels than those for diamines. PnPHT1 was unable to use amino acids as sub- strates. Considering activity was detected for diamines, but not for the corresponding amino acids (e.g., putrescine vs l-ornithine and cadaverine vs l-lysine), PnPHT1 likely recognizes the presence or absence of a carboxy group
